component.name: KDE DJI Mic Mini Control
component.summary: KDE Plasma 6 system tray, USB telemetry & controller for DJI Mic Mini

description.p: KDE DJI Mic Mini Control provides a native KDE Plasma 6 / Kirigami 5-tab desktop control center, live system tray battery badge, real-time wireless transmitter VU meters, hardware setting toggles, USB/HID/DUML protocol inspector, and automatic desktop disconnection popup notifications for the DJI Mic Mini (2ca3:4011) on Linux.

Security hardening (0660 udev + hidraw, Polkit udev installation without sudo on user binaries, strict CRC-16 frame validation, unsafe FFI catch_unwind/QPointer guards, atomic 0600 config writes, explicit subprocess timeouts), major performance optimizations (dedicated background USB/PipeWire worker thread, single-shot JSON snapshot FFI, granular Qt signals, cached tray pixmap rendering, PipeWire pw-record room noise profiling), and modular Rust/QML architecture with native KColorSchemeManager theming.
Added KNotifications 6 integration (.notifyrc) and 15 KDE global keyboard shortcuts via kglobalaccel.
Added Start on Login and Start Minimized to System Tray settings.
Added dynamic application version readout in the window title bar and header, and enclosed all tab views in a unified bordered content box directly attached to the KDE Plasma QQC2.TabBar.

Rust + Qt6/Kirigami C++ rewrite with hardware-aware KStatusNotifierItem tray icon (Active only when microphone is in use), AI Noise Cancellation ambient room learning & automatic TX/RX DSP calibration, and KDE Plasma 6 QML polish.
Added official KDE Plasma 6 Flatpak package (org.kde.Platform//6.11) alongside native Linux archive.
Initial release of KDE DJI Mic Mini Control with DUML v1/v2 USB telemetry, system tray battery badge, and Kirigami 5-tab UI.
